body: It seems there is no need to call this. BoneConstraint3D's properties don't need to be validated here, and its properties will be added to parent class automatically.
I'd like to remove it in #106622

Absolutely no. It is possible to perform validation within child classes, but in order to avoid array splitting, the properties of these child classes must be added to the property list of the parent class.

In other words, this approach is necessary because it extends the parent class struct. If you want to remove it completely, you should remove the parent class itself and duplicate the struct `BoneConstraint3DSetting` into each child classes without extending.
